title: The King of Biebrza River
leadText: A story about searching for harmony between humanity and the natural world.
description:
The King of Biebrza River is the nickname of Krzysztof Kawenczyński - an antiquarian and art enthusiast, who in 1992 left the hustle and bustle of Warsaw and permanently settled in the heart of Biebrza National Park, in the small village of Budy. 

He lives in extraordinary natural surroundings, in an old wooden house full of sculptures, antiques, and unique folk art of Podlasie. His farm is teeming with life thanks to a considerable number of four-legged residents - adopted dogs, cows, and horses. 

The story of the King of Biebrza is not just a charming anecdote from Podlasie - it is above all a reminder of the value of simple life and respect for nature, which we so greatly need in the modern world. 

I invite you to the story of this exceptional character and the search for harmony between man and the natural world. The album is a photographic interpretation of this extraordinary kingdom - an attempt to capture the silence, light, and spiritual peace of a place where time flows at a completely different rhythm.
